test_title: PYST 33: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the main benefit of the Facial Recognition System (FRS) highlighted during the agenda of the August 2025 Parliamentary Consultative Committee meeting on Mission Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0?

options.text: Ensuring benefits reach only genuine beneficiaries
Expanding nutritional coverage to private school children
Providing digital tablets to all Anganwadi workers
Monitoring attendance of Anganwadi staff in real time

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ensuring benefits reach only genuine beneficiaries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Parliamentary Consultative Committee** meeting held in **August 2025** focused on the progress and digital innovations under **Mission Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0**.
 
• One of the primary highlights of the agenda was the implementation of the **Facial Recognition System (FRS)** to enhance the **transparency** and **accountability** of the nutrition delivery ecosystem.
 
• The **FRS** is designed to ensure that the **Take-Home Ration (THR)** and **Hot Cooked Meals (HCM)** reach only **genuine beneficiaries**, thereby preventing leakages and identifying **ghost beneficiaries**. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• This technology is integrated into the **Poshan Tracker** mobile application, which is used by **Anganwadi Workers (AWWs)** across the **country** to monitor service delivery in **real-time**.
 
• The system uses **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** based facial validation to confirm the identity of children (in the **0-6 years** age group) and **pregnant/lactating women** before benefits are dispensed.
